text: Bar is laid-back, off the beaten path so it has more of a local neighborhood-y vibe, family-friendly with a local Fishtown meets Tex-Mex + Cajun theme, and plenty to look at on the walls while you eat/drink. Food is consistently good, and there are vegetarian/vegan options. Seitan wings and fried pickles are delicious, and they usually have a veg-friendly special too. Nacho servings are generous (so be preared to share). They offer flights so you can try a lot of the beers on tap. Nice outdoor, dog-friendly space too when it's warmer out!

We have been coming to Nacho Mamas forever. Really love the tacos, guacamole, fresh chips and queso. Not too fond of the rice and leans and salsas though. But that's a matter of taste. The service is inconsistent - we waited almost 30 minutes today and they weren't that busy... maybe short handed. I find the decor and roadside bar atmosphere great! Definitely recommend.

I was extremely excited to find out that there was a Sakana Express near my boyfriend's house! I love Poke King, but I feel like I end up getting the same thing a lot because the toppings are a little limited. But Sakana Express has SO MANy different options to choose from, including poke and Korean BBQ elements. 

When I finally made it into the location I was a little overwhelmed with the amount of options! But the worker there was very helpful and let me try several different options when I was unsure of what to get. 

I packed my bowl to the brim with toppings (I maybe went a little crazy) but all the toppings were so fresh and delicious and added a different element to my bowl. I loved the fusion of Korean and Japanese and can't wait to try so many different combinations.

This would be 5 stars as wide and I have always loved the breakfast burrito after hiking tumamock hill. This time we noticed the burrito was probably half the size of its original size of multiple years. We were told they now have measured portion control, obviously smaller yet paying the same price. Disappointed

Thanks for making sure the lid to the soup was closed all the way olive garden. All over my white pants. 

Also ordered a total of 6 bread sticks they only put 5

First off, lemme tell ya... lazy, lazy, LAZY staff. Went up to the front desk with a simple request and got reluctant service. Drinks took too long to come that we became quite parched, not fun. This place really exposed my lack of golfing skills as well, which I did not appreciate. Overall just fuck

Stayed here 2yrs ago. It has really gone down. Pool parties with gang tattooed people bringing in coolers. All the pools were disgusting. Things floating in them. Rooms had moldy caulking, towel racks falling off. Filthy curtains. Landscaping over grown. Plastic on the roofs instead of fixing the roof. Poor customer service. Will never go back. A step above motel 6.

This review is a little delayed but better late than never. I have been coming to outlanders since it opened and have always enjoyed the food, the service, and the atmosphere. That being said, my wife and I reached out to Brian early 2020 about catering our wedding which took place in October 2020. Brian was awesome to work with. He does business the old school way, with a notepad and a handshake. Something so refreshing about that. He and his staff went above and beyond and exceeded our expectations in every way. We could not have been happier with the entire experience! Working with Brian and his staff was icing on the cake for us...and of course the food was great as always. Thank you Outlanders!!! Cheers!

Great local spot with Irish dishes. Love this place coz they have country line dancing on wednesdays and the instructor is SO MUCH FUN!
The food is great as well. I tried the fish and chips and it was a total comfort food! Lots of parking outside and just a fun local dive spot everyone should check out!

We ordered take out for dinner and not only was it delicious, the portion size was huge. We got the chicken cannelloni, penne pasta with sausage and a Cesar salad and had no complaints. They included bread and a yummy olive oil/herb dip. Will definitely go back!
Good place after a Garden District tour.  Had the catfish po'boy with Mac & Cheese side.  Service good, pretty popular.  The Mac & Cheese made a 4 star review go to a 5!

I really like this place!  So my wife and I decided to stop by for lunch. We ordered the Caprese Skewers, the Caprese bruschetta, and the Pig pizza. Sounds like a lot but, portion sizes are just right. Service is always great.  There is no designated server here. You enter, order at the counter, pay, than seat yourself. When your food is ready, someone brings it to you.  The Caprese Skewers are served two on a plate. Quite simple with a grape tomato, Cheese, a Basil leaf and balsamic vinegar. The Bruschetta was served as 4 slices with fresh mozzarella, vine-ripened tomatoes, basil pesto & balsamic glaze .Very good!  The pig pizza was also very good. Lots of meat. applewood smoked bacon, italian sausage, pepperoni, smoked ham & sopressata and cheese. A very good lunch. We will be going back.

Close to 5 stars but "no cigar". Their gyro was great!! I personally felt like their was nothing but meat though and the gyro sauce was splashed on there unevenly. Barley any tomato and almost no lettuce, too much onion. 

They mistaken the order too on drinks, although we noticed it was very busy. It happens, but instead of rushing us and running around in circles: think efficiency. 

The food was good, VERY FAIRLY PRICED...4 people for lunch and the bill without tip is $34? That's great! 

Overall a good experience, will come back. Just speak clearly with your order, make your requests known.

Came in for lunch. Small shop with BIG flavor and hospitality! First time in, staff was so friendly  and helpful explaining things. They make bread fresh daily, and all fresh ingredients! Soups rotate, but also have a few that are always on the menu. Sandwiches, soups, salads, sides, and a few desserts. I had the Dar Poeta Sandwich, Chicken Velvet soup, and a side Caesar salad (worked a double that day, so I got lunch and dinner). Sandwich was super good and a lot of that was probably the homemade bread. Dressing on salad was good and super creamy. Soup was also delicious and creamy as well. It's about a block from my work building (just recently moved to) so I will  for sure be back!!
Very good cooked fish of grouper and red snapper. Shrimp appetizer was very nice. Choice of beer was limited but the good choices though being few.

Folks, there's a reason we trust Yelp. 

We ended up here for sheer curiosity. And because I really wanted pasta/pizza/cheese/more cheese and if you're going to eat pasta, pizza, and lots of cheese you also need some wine. And if you're going to have some wine you might as well be somewhere swanky. You know so that the world shines extra bright once you've had too much of it (wine). 

The food is delicious. Completely faultless. The menu is interesting the dishes are unique. I got to try rabbit for the first time and it was super tasty! It was a big hefty portion with a tangy creamy wine sauce and I frankly could have eaten the whole thing. Thankfully I was sharing it, so I couldn't. 

The wine list was underwhelming, however the prices were pretty reasonable (as far as markups go). 

The reason this tasty dinner only gets 3 stars from me is just as you will read in every other review...the service is BRUTAL. Not rude, not mean, just really unpolished. I'm fairly certain the only criteria to being hired here is being attractive and young. Our server was totally personable, and totally good looking and that's where it stopped. They put a carafe of water on your table but never once topped the waters off for us. They "auction" food. They look stressed. I mean it's not bad they're not bad people. They just aren't experienced servers. There's a reason being a professional server is a distinguished career! It takes practice, skill, and passion. 

This restaurant is 5 stars but it'

I DO have to say, this is quite honestly some of the best southern Italian I have had in A.LONG.WHILE! You can tell everything is freshly made- as noted on the menu. The service is just always FUN. There is a reason this place has been here for over 30 years and if you find yourself in the area, STOP IN. 

I haven't tried their pizza- but their pasta dishes are AMAZING! The risotto balls are SO DANG GOOD. Long story short, I find myself here 1-2 days a week slowly but surely going through their menu to find MY FAVE.. you should TOO!
Everything is homemade and many local products. Food was better than expected and service was excellent.

I have given 1 star because there is nothing lower. The worst service you can experience The waitress wave very rude and could not get an order right The food is just as bad as the service. Definitely find a different place to eat

What a GREAT place for a special occasion!  Perfectly Italian... great food... and an all around super experience.  15 of us came to town to celebrate our sisters 50th Birthday.... from 10 to 89 years old we had a night we will never forget.

Surprisingly good for take out. I've ordered from here multiple times during the pandemic and it keeps up a high level of quality.

The pho broth is always nice and flavorful. I would recommend throwing it in a pot on the stove once you get home. The noodles are always pretty good and they add all the fixins you'd normally get in store. Basil, lime, bean sprouts, hoison and sriracha sauce. 

If you aren't eating relatively quick, i would suggest against ordering egg rolls cause they'll just sit and get soft. These are best eaten fresh and crispy.

This place is amazing!   They staff is always super friendly and quick to share a recommendation!! The food is lovely! And there's always an open table! I'd highly recommend it!! 

My hubby and I often come here on date night!  I've never had a bad meal!  We usually order way to much, and stuff ourselves! But it's worth it. The flavors are magical!   We always order the samosas, the garlic naan and the cheese naan. Usually the tandoori chicken, a curry(tried most of them, all tasty!) and the paneer. I'd recommend everything that we have tried!! If you have never done Indian food before, You must order naan! It kind of like your fork... but it's bread!! I wish I could eat every meal with a bread fork!  

Check this place out!! The staff is wonderful and The food is great!

How did I not know about this gem that instantly became a favorite?! I met with my local running club there this past Saturday. After the run, it's completely justified to load up on yummy muffins, right?!  Yes, yes it is. 

I ordered two (one to take home to my husband): a cinnamon crumble and a berry with cinnamon crumble). I almost said it was enough, until I saw sourdough bagels. Two of them made it in my bag. The muffins are a perfect blend of crumbly and moist; not too cakey and not dry at all. And not too light, not at all dense. I believe I just described the Goldilocks of the muffin world. 

But that wasn't all. They have self serve coffee, but it's definitely not tasteless brown water. It is so good! Very fresh, and good depth of flavor. 

I know this place isn't a secret. I just clearly live under a rock or something. Nom nom nom!

The food was amazing! I wasn't aware that you had to order before sitting down, but there was a long enough line that allowed me enough time to look through the menu to decide what I wanted to eat. I got jambalaya, sausage, cheese grits, red beans & rice, and fries. My boyfriend got a fried chicken po-boy and gumbo. The service was great. I would definitely come back.

I'm very upset because there was a hair in the rice and then in my food. I left my plate when I saw the second one midway while eating. I decided to have dessert instead as I had lost my appetite. When I brought this matter up to the owner she was not apologetic and also made me pay for my food while I was still eating. I have been a weekly customer and it was very upsetting to be treated this way. My meal nor experience was worth $15
The restaurant staff were very attentive and professional. They made my wife and I feel very safe . The food and atmosphere were top notch. Would go there again even with my hour drive.

All of the food was excellent! My friend & I LOVED the edamame hummus - seriously DO NOT pass this up (it wasn't on the menu, but I'm so happy I took a chance on it!). Mango roll was delicious as well. Went out on a limb & got the Okinawa Sunset mixed drink which was the perfect complement to my dinner.
Food was great. We got the chicken tikka masala and garlic naan. Would defo recommend that. Atmosphere was pleasant.
Really great coffee. The honey and lavender ice latte and the horchata and sweet cream latter were amazing. The staff is really nice and got us our coffees really quickly!

Texas BBQ without the Texas charm.

Man did I want to love this place. But after waiting 10 minutes for our server to greet us, and 55 minutes for our food...I just can't recommend this spot. 

As a previous server, usually service is the one area I am willing to forgive on. But WOW, y'all. Get your staff in order. 

The food was good, great even. But, it was not earth shattering enough to overcome the poor service, cold atmosphere and long wait. I've yet to feel that unwelcomed in a locally owned Tucson restaurant. 

Like play some country or folk music or something, y'all! The dining room is cold, unfriendly and filled with the echoes of other tables discussing if it's worth waiting "30 minutes" because "the kitchen is short a cutter". 

Again...I really wanted this place to be "THE spot to get BBQ in Tucson". But until ownership fixes how this place is run, I won't be back and will be steering people away. 

OWNERS...get your house in order!  With a bunch of recent reviews mirroring our experiences...it looks you are about to lose the momentum you built at the previous location.

Stopped to eat here while on vacation. Unfortunately, we were here during the tropical storm and it was POURING rain. They have free ( please tip them) valet parking though and that helped a ton! They sat us at the perfect table with views of the ocean. I ordered the buffalo chicken wrap and fries. The buffalo wrap was well stuffed and delicious. My children had kraft Mac n cheese and chicken tenders, both were fine.  My husband ordered the French dip sandwich and it definitely left room for desire. Lack of meat and the onions were large cut and seemed boiled. The au jus seemed to just be beef bullion broth. Our waitress ( I cant remember her name maybe kamil?) gets a 10/10. She was so nice to our children, quick and always there if needed. She helped our kids get animal coconut drink holders ( which can later be used as a piggy bank) and let them choose which ones they wanted.  Unfortunately, my phone had died before arriving.... so I only have the photo my husband took of our kids and their coconuts. We would definitely come back.

The first time I tried anything from here was at the mexican heritage festival in Soulard. Really great churros, the vanilla ones are my favorite! I also have tried the peach tres leches which was pretty good but I cant say it was the best I've had. I am a huge tres leches fan and this was good but there is still better in St. Louis I have found. I love that its locally owned and I would come back here anytime.

As far as my family is concerned there is no other place to purchase doughnuts that can compare to Longs. It's not much to look at, but do not let that stop you from patronizing this establishment ( Southside) on Southport Road.

So we're waiting in line to order at Del Taco and I say to my partner 'why don't we try that place?' He says 'with that name it's gotta be some gringo yellow cheese Mexican food'.

Skip forward a couple of months and my partner comes to me and says 'oh my God my sister and I just had the most amazing Mexican food at that Fiesta Mexicana place'.

It's anything but yellow cheese Mexican, everything I've had has been awesome and as authentic as I've had in Reno.

Try the enchiladas Suiza.. Personal fav.

Go here and tell them you'd like yellow cheese.. Haha

I must have been dreaming when I ate here. Could I really get good seafood in the Midwest!? Not a single complaint at the table. This is definittely a place I plan on returning to and plan on leaving in a dream like state of happiness. Don't skip out on getting the hush puppies either.

While coming through Indy on business, our team stopped for a delicious dinner at Chapati. The atmosphere of the restaurant was a little eclectic, parts seemed culturally traditional while others were more like pop art. That said, it was a comfortable place to be. The game tables and chairs were inviting. 

The food was great. We loved the samosas, and all three of us enjoyed our meals (biryani, kofta and tikka masala). The chapati bread was also quite nice, especially when dipped in the yummy sauces. Oh, and the drinks were great (kashmiri chai and the strawberry banana smoothie). What really made the visit great was the service. While it is an order at the counter restaurant, the staff cares and checks up on the guests. We felt appreciated and well taken care of. We would definitely come back if we lived in the area. 

Taste: 9/10
Presentation: 6/10
Atmosphere: 7/10
Service: 10/10

Yesterday I ordered for dellivery. I ordered the porterhouse steak. I also ordered boudin balls. The steak was one of the toughest steaks I have ever gotten from a restaurant. It was full of grizzle. It was awful. I have eaten at 3 other saltgrass locations and I was always pleased with the food. But this place was the worse I ever had. Then to top off my day,I did not get my boudin balls and I was charged for them. Whoever's the manager of this location needs to get his act together or he should get fired.
Location was kinda away from room. But the service was good and the food was amazing. Came quick and was cooked very well.
I moved to fishtown so I could be closer to Loco Pez. Literally the best thing to ever happen to me.

So many positive things to say about this place! 

*The option to make every burrito vegetarian with the addition of delicious crispy tofu 
*Really (no, really) fresh ingredients
*Large portions for the $
*Delicious sauces (without being too salty or spicy)
*Fast service for to go orders (even on a Friday night)

Only negative is the burritos were somewhat difficult to eat and quite messy.

We became engaged at this restaurant 35 years ago (under the DeLullo name), and decided to return for our 35th wedding anniversary. It was just perfect. They had just opened up inside dining due to COVID, and we were placed at a table with much privacy. We deliberately went on a Sunday night to avoid even minimal crowds- it worked. The ambience is beautiful- intimate and romantic- with soft classical music playing. Carlo was our waiter and was knowledgeable, polite, friendly and attentive. He's also a great photographer as we asked him to take a photo of us... the meals were outstanding - my husband had salmon and I had the homemade ravioli as entrees. Everything was fresh and the presentation/plating was superb. Our shared dessert was presented to us with a lit candle and a warm "Happy Anniversary." We don't live near here but our visit to Moonstruck was special and memorable. Highly recommend!

HANDS DOWN BEST VEGAN MAC N CHEESE!!!

Hands down just amazing food all around!

Now that we live here I try to forget they're open on the weekends so we try new places because I could eat here all day and be happy. My husband said best chicken sandwich vegan or not. 

This place isn't only amazing for a vegan place, they are legit amazing in general. 

Thank you for making amazing food and existing!!

Came over to try the September drink and was happy I did! The dreamsicle is made with a blood orange vodka and is refreshing on those still warm leftover days of summer. The chorizo tacos were amazing and packed full of goodies. My husband also ordered the chicken tacos which were great as well. Fun atmosphere with seating inside or outside.

Well, have to downgrade the rating based on my visit today. Order was incomplete. Paid for the 3 pc chicken tender meal and didn't get the coleslaw. First thing the manager said was she'll make sure that it doesn't happen again. Well...fine, but that's an underwhelming response. Was told then I could come back for it. Drive 10 minutes, 20 minutes total for coleslaw? I don't think so, especially since my lunch break was 10 minutes from being over. Was told I could come back tomorrow to get it. Why would I make a trip just to get a thing of coleslaw? I don't think so, that's ridiculous. One way to judge a company is how they handle their mistakes. This was a so-so way to do so. I should be compensated more, I think, for my trouble. It was payday, I thought I would treat myself. I spent $15 on my lunch there. I could have gotten a good lunch bento for that much. I guess this might have cured me from spending so much money there. Thinking of all the places I could have spent $15 for lunch now leaves me with severe buyers remorse. 

Fries were still outstanding, and of course the rootbeer is the best. The chicken tenders were alright, be sure to definitely get two sauces because one is not enough for 3 pieces. Though I liked the crunch they had, there was too much breading.

The Coney dog was OK, but scant on the onions and would be better if all the cheese was on the dog and not in the container. 

Yeah, you may accuse me by saying that this is just a small deal...whatever. I thi

Service was terrible. Asked for salad with my penne pasta that came out together. Constantly waited for the waitress to come around to fill drinks or ask if we needed anything. Place was not packed at all. She had no personality. Food was good, but definitely will think twice about going back because of the service

Have been here numerous times.  Parking without valet is always a challenge.  It's a bar on the water, and, surprisingly,  there are damned few of them in Tampa.  You don't come here for the food you come here to be in the water.  It's a typical bar menu with sushi thrown in.  I've had burgers, bowls and wings and they were all okay.  Not great but again you don't come here for the food.  It will be interesting to see how this place fares with the new place that just opened down the road.

I've been here before when it was a burger restaurant. We came here on a Monday night and the place was pretty empty. The service was good, our waitress was a bit awkward. Their catch of the day was a pork chop, which was really odd and when our waitress described it she didn't know exactly what was in the dish and had a hard time explaining it. I just ordered the Apple Gouda melt which sounded really good, but it truly was subpar, I could mainly taste just the cheese and there we're barely any apples in it. It just tasted like a grilled cheese to me, nothing special. The fries we're unseasoned and tasteless I could only eat a few. My boyfriend ordered a burger which he said was alright. The prices we're very good, I don't think we'll be back. We weren't impressed at all. I forgot to take pictures of my food but it wasn't much to remember. Thankfully I got my hospitality industry discount so that was nice. For being a local place their beer selection sucked, try to get 81Bay on tap or other different beers from big name local breweries, not just their generic brews.

Great Basin Sparks gets an A. The Mac n cheese with bacon is amazing. My dining companions had fish n chips and tri tip dinner. Still love the industrial cozy ambience of this location. Staff is friendly. Prices are good. Yum!

What a waste of my time.  Let me start by saying they weren't even busy!  330 in the afternoon, maybe 4 tables.  It took way too long to be greeted at our table for drinks.  I'm guessing it was the manager who seated us, took our drink orders then our food orders.  Food came out way too fast.  I get nachos and wings are easy, makes you wonder if it was all under a heat lamp.  Then randomly some lady shows up to our table and took over as our food came.  Not once did anyone check to see how our food was or if we needed a refill.  Overheard the waitress rudely ask the table behind us if the change was her tip lol. Really!  Who asks that!   As I was paying, she asked another table rudely if they needed change!?!?   Won't EVER be back to this dump!!!!!

I've tried this establishment twice now. Once I ordered through Skip the Dishes and the other I went in person. It was at my husband's request that we try it, as he loves finding hidden gems but it didn't live up to the reviews we read or other dinner type restaurants in its category. 

My first impression of their menu was it was designed with care and attention to detail which didn't transfer over to the kitchen. The staff were friendly and approachable, although I couldn't help but notice they were not following AHS guidelines when it came to wearing masks. They did have a sign outside stating that patrons had to wear masks but even those rules were not being enforced by three other customers who were inside. 

The layout of the space was comfortable and simple with an attempt to show some character with old airbrush art showing icons of the past like Marilyn Monroe, James Dean and Elvis Presley in hot rods which seemed out of place and bought second hand. 

There were two booths and a couple of tables to sit at. We chose the booth and reviewed our menus. At that time it seemed that the patrons were mostly truck drivers and people off the highway. Which gave it a truck stop dinner feel along with the food they offered. 

Although the menu was designed well the offerings were ambitious and fell short. We order a Hot Roast Beef with Fries and Gravy and house salad. The food came out quickly and the portions were large, enough to feed two grown adults with a large appetite. T
Service was spectacular. Ben and Taylor were fantastic. Set the pace for the food which was amazing and fast!

Tried both Saba and Shaya two times each on a recent week trip to NOLA.  Saba was by far my favorite.  The pitas were warm and tasted straight out of the over.  The food tasted delicious and fresh and healthy and wonderful all around.  Shaya had similar pitas but they were not warm and tasted like they had been sitting around for the day.  Food was oil and my fish and shrimp dish was a bit fishy.  I vote Saba Saba Saba.

Came here on the recommendation of our airboat captain from airboat adventures. I had the guiness brat which was probably one of the best brats I've ever had. Hubby had rougarou and said it was great. Fries are awesome and the raspberry lemonade daiquiri was really good too. Great find in marigny.

Haven't ate here in forever and I was craving an Asian chopped salad with tenders instead of grilled chicken and not even a simple salad was made correctly. Tenders tasted like it had been reheated so many times and they simply didn't wanna get rid of it no matter how old it was. Tasted disgusting and made my appetite go away. Waste of my money. 

Nothing is made for the quality anymore they rush absolutely everything. Never again.
Omg sooooooooooo good best chicken burrito bowl ever !!!! And the chips and salsa Highly recommend!!

This is my go to spot of late. What a gem. Located inside the Hmart of Elkins Park, on the second floor, you will find a food court reminiscent of the kind you would find in a suburban mall. Instead of a variety of American fast food selections like in a mall there are only asian food options. Which is exactly what an Asian girl needs when she wants to get her nom on.

From korean fried chicken, sushi, noodle, dumpling, Mandi and more, you will have no problem satisfying that authentic asian palate itch.

Clean, generous serving sizes, efficient, tasty variety, prices from the 90's. Place your order with the lady in the plexiglass order box. You will get pick up numbers on your receipt. Today I chose soondubu and beef chow fun. Solid options although the fatty in me could easily order something from each restaurant. 

Pro tip. Eat first, then go downstairs and get your grocery shopping done. There are excellent standards and covid precautions in place.

Anyone in the DMV looking for a day trip? Make a "Pickle Pilgrimage ", from the friendly staff to the, to the pickle juice shots, to the star of the show the exceptional, exceptional pickle sandwiches. You will not be disappointed.

Unassuming spot when you first enter, but follow the hallway to an intimate, dimly-lit dining room. The food is delicious, and has an element of design that makes it beautiful to look at. The staff was friendly and answered all of our questions. Great place for a dinner with friends or date night!

My last two experiences at Founding Farmers were lackluster. Most recently, they changed the entire layout of the main buffet area for brunch. Instead of having multiple stations, everything was moved so people had to form one long line. The line wrapped around and behind the plate area near the booths. It was outrageous!! By the time we got to the buffet twice, they were out of everything we wanted. They could not accommodate the volume of the restaurant. We also had to request the small bites be passed to our table, or we probably wouldn't have seen them. Despite the chaos. Our server was great. He never let our coffee or water run low. But something needs to change with the set up. Not sure I would return for brunch, based on my recent experience. I don't like to fight over food, or wait in a huge line to grab 2 things.

Love this place. The sushi is so fresh. The owner and staff are lovely. I can't say enough good.  They are always welcoming. I get a lot of takeout but eat in as well. The restaurant is small but has such a wonderful, intimate feel. Such a special little gem in an unassuming shopping mall. Absolutely worth the trip every time.
Loved the pancakes, Benedict and the Heavenly Hog. Food was great and servers were prompt and friendly.

I am pleased with the responsive management regarding the disappointing Sacher torte. 

The raspberry chambord is really good. Very smooth mousse with nice raspberry flavor and makes it not a heavy dessert.

The truffles are great too. I had the Meyer lemon, lemon chiffon (both had refreshing lemon flavor). The hazelnut and Gran marnier are pretty good. All the truffles are smooth. Palet D'or is not too sweet at all. 

The liberty bell chocolate is $25 and requires a couple of days to order

Fucked up my order. I got 3 burger sliders and they gave me 3 chicken sliders. What kind of dumb ass shit? I couldn't even go back because by the time I got home they were closed. I didn't waste my food though. Gave it to a homeless dude.

We love it here . My son tried crab legs for the first time with garlic lemon pepper and it had an amazing taste !!! Now he's always asking for some lol (oopsss we going broke)jk he also loves the popcorn shrimp too. My husband & I always get the xtra hoy Mr. & Mrs Crab sauce  very delicious taste . I'm glad I found another seafood spot bc we are from Atlanta and we always go to juicy crab . The flavor is just delicious! I have to try other platters , when I do I will post some pics and reviews.
I've never been here before but I'm sure happy I tried this place. On my last day of work before shutting down, 3 of us on a skeleton crew, shared a Bbq chicken pizza. Delish!
Stopped for a quick meal and ended up waiting 30 minutes for a shit customer service! Never coming back to this awful place.

This is my favorite Chick-fil-A in South County the food is great and the workers are all so very nice and helpful. I have tried almost everything on their menu but the salads are my favorite. Always fresh and the Avacado Ranch dressing is wonderful. If you haven't tried eating here you are missing a great experience

The service was good and the restaurant was clean. The food didn't taste bad, it wasn't really good, the food preps put no energy into checking there ingredients. Several things were old and stale, and undercooked. I wont be going back. Also it's way overpriced for what you get. It's absolutely sub par. I wouldn't bother here.
Our go-to coffee spot in Montecito.  Staff are uber professional and friendly and the coffee is quality.  We haven't tried them yet, but their pizzas and cookies look yummy!

Great food.   I was in Metairie for a physical test and had to wait for results.   I used Waitr and found someone close.
 I would recommend.

Came here for the first time today and legitimately had the best coffee I've ever had in my life! The girl who made my coffee (blonde hair and rly blue eyes) was so sweet and helped me figure out how things worked here. I got an iced Carmel latte with almond milk and she told me the almond milk was made in house and so was the Carmel sauce which was BOMB! The other brunette girl was also super sweet and welcoming. 10/10 service and coffee

I ended up having lunch there on Saturday(1/18/20) in the afternoon around 1:30ish. When, I arrive there it wasn't many cars in the parking lot, I was greeted by Host Eric whose also their Server as well. Place had a few customers in when I had arrived for lunch, very spacious, and clean. For lunch I had the catfish fillets(3) and their regular fries. Also, I had two drinks one drink is one of Crimson Crab's popular drinks called Georgia Peach, and a martini Cosmopolitan. The restaurant is very similar to Juicy's Seafood, and what I wasn't too much of a fan of having my catfish fillets deep fried for the extra crispy crunch. The Server Eric Sun was very helpful especially since it was my first time there, gave me his recommendations on drinks, and kept checking on me. Also, the restaurant does have drink specials on certain days, and even Jazz musicians performing which will be Fri. January 24th, 2020. I was informed if you have a Facebook page that's where you can find their latest events.
Rude and waited for 20 mins no service. Asked for water and said I had to pay for a full price soda.

This is my mom and my all time favorite restaurant in the Indianapolis area. We stumbled upon it when we were running other errands in Indy. She's from Bloomington, I'm from South Bend but any time we end up in the Indianapolis area this place is a must. The food is next level. We've had the burrito bowls, veggie tacos, fajitas, fajitas nachos - every dish is amazing. The margaritas are delicious and an absolute steal. We like the salsa so much that we order some to take home  If you're ever in the mood for Mexican and in the area, you've got to give them a try!

Stopped here on a Sunday evening for dinner and had the place to ourselves. Not sure why, though. The food was excellent and even a great presentation. We didn't browse through the attached market, but we will be back!  It truly is a gem tucked away in an unassuming location.

I want to say how impressed I was this morning on my visit to the Co-op. I am a senior and went there early to avoid crowds and because they have hours for seniors between 8-9. The doors very clearly state these hours for seniors. Someone came in the store that was clearly much younger and was asked to leave and come back after 9AM. Thank you to the staff that follow through to ensure our safety during these scary times. You are amazing!!!

Beautiful place. Ambiance is nice. Tables are low and a little close. Short Rib is to die for. My wife and I have been there twice and will definitely be back. You can bring kids but I would suggest more for a date.

First time.....LAST time. Went for breakfast sandwich to go. They were out of sausage. Bagel selection was scant. Ordered bacon, egg and Swiss on a bagel. I asked for toasted bagel. It was barely warm. Bacon was almost non existent on the sandwich. When you pay $5?for a breakfast sandwich, at least they should get the order right!!

From service to food it was an excellent night! Our server was so attentive and even made me feel special when celebrating my husband's birthday by bringing me a "mocktail" while I was 33 weeks pregnant! It was thoughtful and definitely one of the reason we will be back to celebrate more occasions here.

I go here often Bc it is close to our house but they always seem to forget something on my order when I go through their drive thru and there is hardly anything on the sandwiches - no matter which one. The quality of the food w panera seems to be going down in general - all locations - I'm lucky to get 3 small slivers of chicken on the frontega chicken panini anymore and honestly it's making me go here less & less as a whole, which is a bummer Bc I used to really enjoy Panera's food. 
This location however, is by far my least favorite as my order is always messed up & the quality is never good. Panera really needs to step it up as far as food quality goes, they claim their stuff is 'fresh' and I've opened salads with wilted lettuce to the point that it looked like it was bad long ago & have had to throw it out entirely. There are to many other places / options available now and so I'm finally cutting ties w this location especially due to poor quality and customer service. Don't waste your time or $ - you'll leave with food you have to toss in the trash when you get home.
Just got a cheese pizza $15 where's the cheeseBrought it home ate one slice I'm thinking it needs more cheese so I put a lot of my cheese on it and then it tasted pretty good

FAST service! 
As soon my sister walked up to the door to pick up our orders, they had it ready to go. She was back in the car within 30 seconds. 

I have been craving a real meatball sandwich ever since I switched to being a pescatarian, so I ordered the Impossible Meatball Sandwich, which was pretty decent! Other food that I got a taste of was the Spicy Bahn Mi, very good! Along with our order we got the Shroomy Mac & Cheese. The container was HEAVY (always a great thing) because my sister loved it and had leftovers. 

Of course, we need something sweet. So, we ordered two chocolate chip cookies and the Cherry Pecan brownie. Now let me tell you, first come first served.. delicious!
Love the food and thank you for doing Uber eats! I got the coconut chicken platter and my husband did the mojo tofu platter. Both fabulous.

Please please please read. The lunch specials are tiny! I mean like a microwave dinner small. The fries rice is strange, yellow, mushy and not what I expected fried rice to taste like. Lastly the entree portion is super small. I had maybe 7 small pieces of beef on my Mongolian order. The taste of it wasn't too bad.

The positives are the cucumber lemon water, the price for the lunch special was only 5$, although that doesn't justify the portion or terrible fried rice and the cashier was nice. Try another place.

This is my style of wing! They're smaller than other places, but that's ideal for the sauce to meat ratio. Had 4 of the sauces and they were all creative and unique. Prices are great. Definitely coming back again to try more. Fries and okra were good.

Good food. Nice portions. A little pricey, but consistently good quality. Sign up for their email advertising and they will send you an offer for a free breakfast. They will also send you an offer for a free breakfast for your birthday. Pretty cool of them to do that. Place is always clean, and service is good too. Lots of comfort foods.

We had initially decided to try Cafe Du Monde but after learning that the only thing avail was beignets and coffee, we looked for another place. We tried French Toast since was nearby and had terrific reviews. The wait was 35 minutes but well worth it. I really enjoyed their latte and ham/cheese omelet. 
I will be returning tomorrow morning before leaving the city.

I am very disappointed with Beefy's. I ordered lunch from there yesterday for my girlfriend and I. It was absolutely disgusting! I had the Kansas City burger and my girlfriend had the pastrami burger. We also got a side of garlic fries, fried zucchini, and fried pickles. The burgers were over cooked, the buns were soggy and just thrown together very sloppy. All of the sides were just soaked with grease. Like they didn't have their deep fryer's turned up high enough and all the food was just soaking in the grease. I spent $40 just to throw more than half of the food away! What a waste of $40! I feel like I should get a voucher or my money back!

Got home with order and was very disappointed! Simply ordered a 4 wing meal with extra side. Should of checked the bag! Got home and it was a 4 piece meal without the side. Sure its chicken but pay attention to what is ordered. The staff was distracted  and had private laughter going on. A good manager would keep their staff focused.

We had Johnny Carino's cater our wedding a couple of year ago, and they executed it flawlessly! We went to several caterers for taste testing and prices, etc- other places were okay, but Carino's was on point with everything we tried. The food was so good, we couldnt wait to share with our guests. 

Today, we drove almost an hour in the rain to enjoy the food again. The service was amazing, too. Virginia was our serving, and we could not have asked for anyone better. 
Very attentive, fast, and easy to talk to. We have been here several times now, and we enjoy it every time. The 16-Layer Lasagna is amazing! My husband's favorite is the Spicy Chicken Romano. Everything was delicious! We also tried their boneless bbq wings- so good!! I got soup to go with my meal- soup of the day was Chicken & Wild Rice. So creamy and delicious. Their bread and oil are yummy, as well. Highly recommend!
Craig was our server. He did a fantastic job. Always made sure we had fresh iced teas. Love that. Sushi was amazing.

This restaurant will be my go to breakfast spot in Santa Barbara. They give out baskets of delicious muffins during your wait. The food was quite good. The chicken fried steak was some of the best iv had in california.
   Then theres the Owner Chad himself. He was killin it. Running around cleaning up bussing tables, talking to people, giving muffins to the people and water to the dogs waiting for a table. He genuinely cared about peoples experience and he made it amazing for us. 
    If other Restaurants in Santa Barbara hold this standard of food then i cant believe anyone eats at home. It was a very good start to a very good day and i appreciate everyone at Chad's. Love from Reno.

The closest thing that I've found to New York style pizza in Philly. Love the thin crust and every slice has the right amount of cheese and sauce. 

The sandwiches are pretty good too. I'll be back.
The worst cheese steak ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Just do yourself the favor and don't even try it !!!!!!!!!!!!

The food was excellent. The service was incredibly slow. Our drinks took 5 minutes. The appetizer didn't come out for over 20 minutes, and it was chips and queso. It only arrived after we asked for it. Our meal arrived within a minute of the appetizer. 

Only checked in twice during the entire visit. 

We came in for a late lunch at 3:00 pm so it wasn't during any peak times.

Thai X-Press has become our Friday lunch ritual. We love visiting Philay and catching up. Everything she makes is wonderful and fresh. My favorite is the pumpkin curry and my husband loves the green curry. One visit, I brought my picky six year old daughter and she made her rice and even bought her ketchup and a donut from next door! Not only is the food great, but Philay is a charming, wonderful person who takes pride in her craft. Don't let the construction get in the way of visiting this gem! This is the kind of place you gravitate to because of the community it creates.
The bread is excellent. The counter staff is rude. The last two times the counter person has been curt and dismissive. If you can overlook the poor service, go for it.

Stopped by to use some gift cards and try the new flatbread pizzas which we really enjoyed several years ago before they were discontinued.  Service when placing order was pleasant.  However, order was inputted wrong.  When I pointed out error to the pickup window, I was met with some serious attitude.  Once we got our pizza, it was awful.  I can accept mediocre, but this was truly terrible.  Crust was like cardboard, sauce had no flavor, and cheese was ???   We commented that it reminded us of the Chef Boyardee pizza in a box we made as kids; although that would be doing a disservice to Chef Boyardee.  We will not be back to this location.  Management needs to address some serious personnel and quality issues.

Such a cute outdoor spot. Food was amazing and you can't beat the view! Whenever we are in town this place is a must to visit. Also the water park is amazing for kiddos. Walking around the river after dinner is all the dessert you need!

Visited Joeys for a take out order. Ordered a medium mushroom and anchovy pizza to go. Ate the whole pizza overlooking a park and waterway. Most enjoyable! Will visit again for a dining experience. It was very satisfying.

I placed a to go order yesterday, and when I went to pick it up, the hostess abruptly stated "thank god." I was not late picking up my order. Yes it was seafood, however that is not the way to greet someone when they walk in. It made me feel like my order was an inconvenience and my business was not appreciated. I called to speak to a manager and the lady who answered the phone said there was not one.  It's not even 4pm. Definitely shared this experience with my colleagues today
Keisha is absolutely awesome! She gave us everything we needed and more......plus a smile.  Come get you some pizza!!

My fiance and I have lived in Northern Liberties for a little over year, but have not tried Apricot Stone until tonight. We would always see the restaurant at its capacity every time we walked by. Finally, we decided to give it a try, mainly on a whim, and we both agree that we will definitely be back. 

We decided to get the "dinner for two" option, which includes enough to feed three for reasonable price of 55 dollars total (pre-tip). The baba ghanoush, muhamara, jajukh, and filet kebabs were so delicious. the meat was cooked perfectly and was tender and juicy while still maintaining that grilled smoky flavor and texture. 

In our humble opinion, a lot of their dishes are on par with Suraya (which is also phenomenal and lives up to the hype). However, for the price, and the quality service, this restaurant definitely deserves a lot more attention. 10/10 would recommend.

Been there a few times before Lightning games and Irish pub fare is pretty authentic and parking great. It's only a few blocks from the arena and beer and food better and less expensive than eating at the arena. Service was good and friendly and there were other fans there as well.
Went here last night and the sushi was fresh and tasty! I'm pretty pick when comes to sushi. Have to say their ramen very light and delicious. Will come here again.

Tex mex on the westbank, and let me tell you it's the real deal. Huge portions, and the food is delicious.   My girl is from Austin and she agrees, this place is the bomb.  And it's well priced.  Better than anything you'll find on the east bank.   Servers are very friendly as well.

BaklavaDoner Plate the food is Delicious!
What a hidden gem! Thank you Z for such a great experience.

Went for dinner last night.  Was disappointed because we always have had great experiences there.  The Caesar and Wedge Salads were great as was the 8 oz. filet mignon for $41, which I thought was a little steep.  The crab cakes were tiny and disappointing.  There aren't as many menu options available.  The service was terrible.  After drinks and food were served, we never saw our waiter again until we actually stood up to leave before he brought us our check.  I was very surprised as it wasn't that busy. We will wait a month or two before we patronize this restaurant again.
This is delicious. Healthy, mostly organic. Great find in the city for lunch. Able to customize. Gluten-free. Variety of choices. Excellent portion size. Thank you!!

The Take-out interface was very user friendly. We did the $25 deal (2 pizzas and a growler). The food was ready right on time! The pizzas were delicious and the beer was ice cold! Will definitely order again.
Great food and drinks (appreciate the nondairy options for smoothies!), we just arrived when a lot of things were sold out. I hope next time we go we can try their bbq mushroom sandwich.

I've been ordering from Lemon Tree for months. Their sandwiches, salads & soups are amazing. I have NEVER been dissatisfied or disappointed. I highly recommend them, for sure 5 stars! Thank you Lemon Tree!

Best in town, the cake I got for my best friend anniversary was everything. Yes I said it and it was all butter cream baby just the way I like it..... They never disappoint and always on time. Check them out ASAP and the price is great!!
Second time ordering from here to go. Food is excellent quality and delicious. Plan on going to sit in soon and enjoy the restaurant inside. Glad I found this place
Best burger restaurant in Edmonton hands down! The best burger is the PB & J with a side of poutine! Friendly staff, timeless decor with old movies always on the tv's. A YEG staple.

Average chain food at very high prices.  Service is hit or miss.  Bread was improved from last visit.  But I couldn't get a second loaf because the kitchen was closing half an hour before posted closing time.  Still looking for a really good Italian restaurant in the metro area with reasonable prices.

I made an order for carry out that somehow got switched over to delivery so I waited at home. It never came. The store closed so I got a call the next afternoon saying that the delivery address on the order was the store's address. My phone number was on the order. I didn't receive a call before delivery to resolve the issue. The pizza that was delivered to me the next day had to be the pizza from the night before. It was cold and dry. This all costed me $28. Very disappointing.

I love the energy of this place, cool pub vibe and interesting craft cocktails but the food was really terrible.  We had a party of six and are pretty easy going but this was an off night I guess.  The fried pickles were yummy and crunchy but the pizza, hummus and salads were underwhelming. Maybe they were training new cooks, it was a Tuesday night.

I ordered a pizza with extra cheese and extra meat. I did not receive it at all. I've ordered pizza's from them for years but things have changed drastically.  The crust was hard, no sauce, less than 12 pepperonis for a large pizza. I was informed they have a new manager. If they need to make cut backs that extreme just to make profit then something is wrong. They can't keep drivers so their is usually a significant delay. The pizzas use to be worth the wait but not anymore. I suggest you order from anywhere but Rockville Road. At least the other Piezanos will give you what you. For more information I can be contacted at aharris3520@yahoo.com.

4 different prices for same fried chicken. Cold probably as 1 of 2 heat lamps out. Not cleanest surroundings and nice but not smart nus boy waiter could have cared less. Sunocp station on rte. 29 had same chicken. DONT WASTE YOUR TIME HERE. 
.

Food is AMAZING, but service is lacking. Waited 20 minutes for a table, which would have been fine if someone acknowledged that we were there. Once we sat we waited 15 minutes for someone to bring water and take our order. The best part - a 20% tip was included in the check even for a party for 4. It was like they expected a less than tip. The food is the only thing bringing me back.

My wife and I had dinner out for the first time since early March...and we chose Ocean Prime as we were celebrating her birthday.  While there have been some expected and notable changes, the entire experience  - from booking to our departure - was classic OP excellence. 

First & foremost: make a reservation!!  Whether it be via Open Table, calling, or however you choose to do it - due to limited (50%) capacity, you cannot walk in (as in lounge Happy Hour).   

We booked via Open Table and received a text 15 minutes before we arrived asking us to confirm that we were on our way.  Easy enough.  We were greeted at the exterior door by the hostess and then quickly seated in a booth in the lounge (per our request). 

Service was quick and as always, impeccable!   Drinks were just as we recollected.  Apps too.  Same with entrees.  The only thing missing was live entertainment (in the lounge), but this is understandable as OP is trying to make up for some heavy financial losses over the last 2 months.  We look forward to the return of music as they have always booked great acts (e.g. Todd, Jariah, Teddy).

All in all, OP has certainly maintained its high standards.
The atmosphere was perfect, the dinners were delicious.  Octopus, eggplant parm, chicken parm and chicken Marsala.  Definitely would recommend!

swah-rey is a slice of heaven. The cake slices are huge and soooo good. Whether you're eating in or taking out, their sweet treats are 10/10. I got a tip from Michelle to leave the cake outside the fridge for a couple of hours before eating so the buttercream gets soft and creamy. It really makes a great cake even better. 

Their coconut cake is AMAZING, especially with one of their lattes. I always stop by when I'm in the area and highly recommend it. Their mini cupcakes are also phenomenal and a great value. One of the best parts of DTSP!

My boyfriend and I walked in there on a Saturday night and it was very packed. It is a small place. They had one booth open which they said was reserved and attempted to seat us at this SUPER TINY square table in the middle of the room that they had piles of napkins and utensils sitting on. No, thank you. If you want to be seated on a weekend night, it seems like it is best to make a reservation. It was also very noisy and loud. It is too bad we didn't get a chance to taste the food. I'm sure it is good but I am leaving this review based on the atmosphere and lack of hospitality.

We picked this place because we wanted to watch the CFP and they had the most TVs. This is a place you only choose because it has TVs, except if you aren't in the sitting in the middle or at the bar it's really hard to watch your game because the TVs are on opposite walls. The food had no flavor. We had catfish with green beans and fries and a chicken quesadilla. If it wasn't for the hot sauce and salsa, it would have been like eating styrofoam. The waiter really wanted to watch the basketball game on. I've never had a waiter avoid eye contact so much. We left at halftime.

What a hidden gem! I was thrown off by the tent in the front. I wasn't sure if I was at the right place and the parking was a bit hard since it wasn't all flat surface. There was a sign that said there was parking the back but we parked in the front instead. The place looks homey. A lot of tables for big groups and for 2. We were able to get a table for 2 right away and we went at 11am.

The breakfast tacos were in small tortillas but were stuffed. I liked that they didn't layer each ingredient. They had the scrabbled eggs mixed in with the sausage and cheese then topped with the onions and tomatoes. 

The stuffed french toast is perfect for someone who doesn't want something overly sweet but enough to satisfy your sweet tooth. It doesn't come with syrup but I did ask for it to add to the sweetness. I would say a donut somewhere would be sweeter than the stuffed french toast, without the syrup if you wanted a comparison. 

Fast check out if you use your card since they use their gadget that connects to their phone. 

I would definitely come back because I wanted to try their biscuits and gravy and mimosas. Variety of food here for breakfast.

Prince's is one of the best hot chicken joints in Nashville. They consistently serve delicious, juicy chicken. I gave it 4/5 because the service could be improved, but the chicken itself gets a 5/5. Warning to those who have never tried prince's: air on the side of getting it too mild. You can always go hotter next time, but your gut won't forgive you if you go too hot (trust me on this)

My boyfriend and I checked out this place after a recommendation and it was very good! We started with the squid appetizer which came in a skewer breaded with a sauce on top, very delicious, the breading was crispy and the squid was tender. Then we both had the tan tan deluxe, it has a nice rich broth and was seasoned well, the cha-shu pieces were really big and nicely grilled, the eggs had the perfect yolk and were nicely salty, the noodles were firm and delicious, I liked the bits of cabbage as well, I can not wait to come back and try another bowl. Beautiful inside and service was good.

My family visited for the first time recently with a party of six on a Sunday and were blown away. The restaurant was really clean, the service was quick and friendly, and the food was great! Our server, Michelle, was super nice, never made us feel rushed and was very attentive. The owner, Moe, came over to introduce himself and see how everything was since it was our first visit. The food was plentiful and delicious. Can't wait to go back soon!

BEST SUSHI IN ST LOUIS. Period. I like "complicated" rolls with lots of crunchies and flavors and toppings (they have simple ones as well of course). Have tried maaaaany places all over the city and county and no other comes close. Prices are really good too; some other places are on the verge of being good but they're wayyy too expensive. I will never go to a different sushi place in St. Louis!
Pretty good! There was a cruise ship singer when we went and it was pretty entertaining. The pizza looked amazing! I had the chicken Marsala. Very nice place.

We had dinner here on a Friday night. Nice clean place, even the bathroom.  They have a good selection of IPAs and our waitress was helpful in choosing one. I had the Korean wrap which had pork and kimchee. It was good and spicy. Husband had a burger that we were assured was fresh and never frozen. He said it was very tasty. There were several people at the bar, they seemed like regulars. It made the place cozy, like a happy place to meet.
Worst fried chicken i ever had for real. I dont know why it so hype. I'd rather to have popeyes

So good!  You can order deli stuff to go or get food and hang out.  i had a smoked turkey sandwich that was tasty, but the pickles they give you really make the dish.  Like everywhere in New Orleans I went, everyone is so friendly and we felt right at home.  A must visit if you are in town.  I think this is my favorite of all the restaurants in the Link group.

My friends and I went to WOB after a wedding and bartender Devon was rude and downright unprofessional to our entire group. Not only was she providing slow service for a practically empty bar, when we did have the displeasure of being served by her she was curt and obviously annoyed by our presence. She refused to get another drink for one of us because 'by law' she could not fill another drink before we finish the first. We all work in the service industry and know that this was untrue, just pure laziness. Two members of our party ordered waters and when another person asked for one she blatantly said no, kindly pointing out that we could all share the two we already received. Absolutely would not recommend World of Beer to my friends. I understand why it was so empty inside on a Friday night. Anthony & other staff were kind to our party but one person has ruined our entire experience.
The service was authentic food was amazing.  Shrimp diabla was perfect.   Burritos made fresh

If you are craving pierogies like I was, you absolutely have to get here!  After 3 orders of the sauerkraut I want more! Next time bacon & cheddar!   Great beer selection, super clean, Hanna & Chris were great! No pictures they went too quickly

We hosted my sister's bridal shower at the bakery and it was absolutely perfect. The staff was friendly and attentive, the food was was delicious and the DESSERTS!!!! The staff quickly jumped on chilling the champagne we had brought and were on top of making sure there was plenty of food. They provided linens, flowers, prepared champagne flutes with raspberries, juices for the mimosa bar, and the best food I've had at a bridal shower all at a very reasonable price. I feel guilty taking credit for all the compliments we received from the guests when Saint Peter's Bakery deserves all the credit. Thank you, thank you, thank you all for making the day so special for all of us!!

Good Mexican food. Tacos are 2.99. What else is there to say. I got a chimichanga plate chorizo and it was good. Definitely made me super full. The beans were not hot though, very Luke warm. The salsa is very good though. The red is nice and spicy.
I've always received good food from this place. My go-to pizza spot in this area. Great pizza and the cheese steaks are delicious.
H e been there countless times and takeouts too. Best country cooking and family atmosphere.

Crappy....and I mean crappy customer service. This is the SECOND time they have messed up my order and SECOND time they argued with a customer. They're clearly not doing well if they have to argue with a customer over RICE. I order a meal with fried rice and get two containers of WHITE rice. Then they argue with you and tell you that's not what you ordered. AND they automatically make anything you order a meal and not a combo just upcharge. You can get Chinese food anywhere- so I suggest you do it anywhere but HERE.

Very disappointed by this place. I got the green curry and vegetable dumplings and it was terrible. The seating arrangement is very odd and it almost seems they don't want you to eat in. However it was later in the night and maybe I was there while they were cleaning up. The dumplings had to be out of a plastic freezer bag and had this awful plastic taste to them. I also can't believe the price of a wonton soup container filled with curry and 3 pieces of vegetable in it and spring rolls was almost $25 dollars. I am very against leaving bad reviews unless I really feel it is deserved and this is definitely spot on for this place. I hope that it was a bad night and they pick it up!

If you are reading this and looking for a Mexican restaurant in the Donelson area and you don't know which one to pick...CHOOSE HABANERO GRILL! This is the best restaurant in the area, hands down. 

I just moved to Nashville from Southern California...so, I have really been missing Mexican and Hispanic food in general. I have tried quite a few Hispanic restaurants since moving here and I have been disappointed each time. Habanero Grill is the best! The food is great and the employees are super nice.
By far the best NY style pizza I've had in a long time.  We did not try their other menu items, but I'm sure they are way above average.  Great price, but a small cute place to go eat.

Not bad. Good food and good portions. Friendly staff but a lil slow. Ordered the seafood platter which was good but overloaded with fries, toast and a so called salad. Would have been better if it had more seafood.

This coffee shop was located next to my hotel in New Orleans. While most of the days I just got an americano from the cafe in my lobby I tried this one out once and it was amazing. Not only was the americano perfect, but the baristas were refreshingly unpretentious and helpful. I highly encourage everyone to try this cafe out!

Hole in the wall BBQ spot that is next door to a salon. Initially started by serving customers at the salon next door because the clients would get hungry while they were getting their hair done.

One of the top BBQ restaurants in STL. The menu is comprised of turkey products, but they have lots of other options as well. The house favorite is the turkey ribs.

I came for lunch around 45 min after they were supposed to open, but it was still closed when I got there. The owner saw me there and unlocked the p 

I got the turkey ribs with sides of mac&cheese and sweet potatoes and everything was fresh and delicious. The ribs literally fell off of the bone

Tried this place and was disappointed all around. We ordered three bowls. My friend ordered the shrimp bowl with lettuce and cheese only. Minimal shrimp. The "fresh greens in all three was more like bagged cabbage. The beans were black eyed peas and they added things he requested be left off. The brisket bowl had 2 small pieces of meat and again not greens or beans. The turkey bowl had about 3 bites of tuerkey... dry. Weak drinks.
While there someone scolded a patron over the loud speaker about tipping after a man with an off the grid logo hat yelled at the customer. Found this interesting since the service is that of a food truck. They just call your name when the food is ready. No real "service"
Now that I know it's part of aqua prime I won't be going there either.
